items.description: Painting disturbed wall area and closing wall opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening created to reach the pipe is covered under 7.1.7(a), and repainting the affected wall area falls within 7.1.5. Priced at a customary painter rate for one small patch.
Under 7.1.7(f) the first travel charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified. Taken at the full prior rate of about 81 per flat rate.
Consumable installation material is covered under 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(d). One piece at a small customary price.
This replacement pipe section is the first pipe charge on the invoice and is covered under 7.1.7(c). Priced at an installed-material rate for 1 m.
Insulation formed part of the component as installed before the loss, so it is covered under 7.1.7(c). Rate taken from the earlier rock wool line, about 18 per unit.
Trade labour is covered under 7.1.7(g). One hour at a customary installer rate.
The contractor's own diagnostic and measuring devices are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
Labour is covered under 7.1.7(g). Taken at the prior rate of about 47/hr x 9 hrs, giving about 425.
Under 7.1.7(f) only the first travel charge per invoice is indemnified, so this second charge is not.
Drying before the repair and a flat-rate equipment deployment once per drying operation are covered under 7.1.7(b) and (e). Priced at a customary dryer flat rate.
The contractor's own blades and reusable tools are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
Fittings used in the repair are covered under 7.1.7(c). Two pieces at about 25 each.
This repeats the pipe charge in pos. 4. Under 7.1.8(c) only the first such charge is indemnified.
This duplicates the insulation already billed in pos. 5 for the same short section, so it is not indemnified under 7.1.8(c) and (d).

An identical second labour line likely falls under the duplicate rule (7.1.8(c)) or the reasonable-time limit (7.1.7(g)). However, the claim mentions two site visits, so it may be genuine; if paid, about 47/hr x 9 hrs.
